hook: Two TGSRTC buses collide on Miyapur-Madinaguda road, *5* hurt
hook_b: Two TGSRTC buses collide on Miyapur-Madinaguda road, *5* hurt
tldr: Two TGSRTC buses collided on the Miyapur-Madinaguda road on Friday, leaving at least five passengers with minor injuries. No deaths were reported.

beats.what: The impact damaged the front of one bus and the rear of the other, per Telangana Today.
beats.why: The report does not give the cause of the collision.
beats.care: Both are busy Secunderabad routes to the west: Lingampalli (AC) and Patancheru (Metro Deluxe).
